name: Scratch
description: Self-hosted offline build of the official MIT Scratch 3.0 editor — no accounts, no online community features, just the block-based programming editor served as static files via nginx.

notes.text: The 4 CPU / 6 GB RAM default is only for the one-time build: the installer clones scratch-editor and runs 'npm run build' across the whole workspace (scratch-storage, scratch-vm, scratch-render, scratch-paint, scratch-gui, ...), and that webpack/TypeScript build peaked at ~4 GB RAM and ran noticeably faster with more CPU cores in testing. Once the build finishes, the container only serves the compiled static files via nginx and idles at a fraction of that — feel free to shrink CPU/RAM afterwards (e.g. 1 CPU / 512 MB) if you want to reclaim host resources, and raise them again before running the update script.
This is the offline Scratch-GUI editor only. There are no user accounts, no cloud save, and no access to the online Scratch community — projects are saved/loaded as local .sb3 files from the browser.
